Several days (12 graves all over the map, 7 bosses with a team and King Zelos; each boss only every 20 h)

{npc:Jack Springer}, of the Thais Inquisition, has discovered that the cultists of the Shiron'Fal, the ancient *legion*, are raising the bodies of fallen knights as powerful lich-knights. Visit the 12 graves he has located, from Edron to Kilmaresh and the {wiki:Cobra Bastion}, sanctify them with holy water and defeat the lich-knights that have already risen. At the end you go down beneath the {wiki:Isle of the Kings} to stop the ritual meant to resurrect the ancient king {creature:King Zelos} and receive the **Hand of the Inquisition** outfit and the achievement **Inquisition's Hand**.
Sanctify 12 graves of fallen knights to uncover the sinister aims of the lich-knights and stop them from ravaging Tibia and plunging the world into darkness.
Jack Springer, Inquisition headquarters (2 floors below Thais)
Level **250** (recommended **300**). The {wiki:Cobra Bastion} also only lets in characters of level 250 or higher.
Having done the **first 4 puzzles** of the *The Revenge of the Ogres* mission of the {wiki:Kilmaresh Quest} (the Kilmaresh grave comes after that dungeon's 6 puzzles).
Access to {wiki:Vengoth}: have at least started mission 4 (*The Dark Lands*) of the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest}, so that {npc:Harlow} takes you there.

Access to the {wiki:Isle of the Kings} for the final boss: be a friend of {npc:Dalbrect} (the *Family Brooch*, first part of {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest}). The alternative is the long and dangerous route of {wiki:The Queen of the Banshees Quest}.
A {item:Cheesy Figurine} (only for the Cobra Bastion chess game, which gives access to {creature:Scarlett Etzel}; not needed to sanctify the grave).
Team: up to **5 players** in each grave boss room and up to **10** for {creature:King Zelos} (a full team is recommended).
{spell:Levitate} and a {item:Rope} to reach the Cobra Bastion chess board.
Money for travel (boats to Edron, Cormaya, Carlin, Folda, Darashia, Ankrahmun, Yalahar, Vengoth, Issavi and Isle of the Kings).
bought from Jack Springer for 100 gp each; take several
replaces the missing queen in the Cobra Bastion chess game; drops from Cobra Scouts (and some Corym) and can be bought on the Market
to climb back out of the holes (Ghostlands crypt, Cormaya, Orclands, Ancient Temple) and for the chess trapdoor
single-target fire damage on King Zelos
to heal Azaram's Soul in the first rounds
Plenty of potions and fire runes: fire is the recommended element against almost every boss.
Base {wiki:Hand of the Inquisition Outfits|Hand of the Inquisition} outfit (when you report to Jack Springer after killing King Zelos)
Boss experience: 55,000 XP for each grave lich-knight, 20,000 XP for Scarlett Etzel and 75,000 XP for King Zelos

{creature:King Zelos} loot: always {item:Crystal Coin|Crystal Coins} and {item:Silver Token|Silver Tokens}, often {item:Gold Token|Gold Tokens} and potions, and with luck {item:Crown Armor}, {item:Galea Mortis}, {item:Toga Mortis}, {item:Mortal Mace}, {item:Bow of Cataclysm}, {item:Death Oyoroi} or {item:Shadow Cowl}

{creature:Scarlett Etzel} loot: {item:Crystal Coin}, {item:Silver Token|Silver Tokens}, lots of potions and, very rarely, a piece of the Cobra set ({item:Cobra Hood}, {item:Cobra Sword}, {item:Cobra Crossbow}, {item:The Cobra Amulet}, etc.)
When you report to {npc:Jack Springer} after killing {creature:King Zelos}.
Hand of the Inquisition addons (Hand of the Inquisition Outfits Quest)
The base outfit from this quest is the starting point for the addons.
The addons are obtained with a {item:Final Judgement} and a {item:Shadow Cowl}.
By killing the miniboss {creature:Gaffir}, on the 3rd floor.
Final area of the Cobra Bastion
By killing the {creature:Custodian}, in the basement.
Chess area on the 6th floor of the Cobra Bastion
By killing {creature:Guard Captain Quaid}, on the 4th floor. Open the doors from the inside to leave them open for good.
Scarlett Etzel's room (boss repeatable every 20 h)
By solving the chess puzzle with the {item:Cheesy Figurine}: everyone in the room gains access.
Having completed the Order of the Cobra access (Cobra Bastion) in this quest is one of the requirements.
You also need the Order of the Falcon access, from {wiki:The Secret Library Quest}.
Fight with King Zelos (repeatable every 20 h)
After sanctifying the 12 graves and reporting to {npc:Jack Springer}.
Up to 10 players; 24 minutes inside the room.

You can sanctify the graves in whatever order suits you best: the spoiler doesn't impose an order. Six only need a visit and the holy water (Dark Cathedral, Femor Hills, Kilmaresh, Vengoth, Orclands and Folda); the others have bosses.
Each boss (the grave bosses, Scarlett Etzel and King Zelos) can only be repeated every **20 hours**. Plan several days of play with your team.
Always carry the {item:Vial of Potent Holy Water} with you. If you need more, go back to {npc:Jack Springer} and ask for a {key:trade}.
Almost every boss should be attacked with **fire**, and on many of them you should avoid **death** damage: check the table in the *Fight summary* step before each fight.

Several bosses apply {wiki:Hexed|Lesser Hex} (reduces healing received to about half) and King Zelos applies {wiki:Status Condition|Greater Hex} (max health at 40%). The blocker has to keep an eye on the status bar.

The whole island of Kilmaresh and the {wiki:Order of the Cobra|members of the Order of the Cobra} are dangerous. To hunt in the {wiki:Cobra Bastion} the wiki recommends level **350** for Knights and **300** for Paladins and mages.
1. The Inquisition: talk to Jack Springer (Thais)
The quest starts and ends at the Inquisition headquarters, beneath Thais. Here you accept the mission, buy the holy water and, at the end, ask for access to the final boss.

Go to **Thais** (by boat, at your city's harbour: {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Captain Bluebear}). In the city, go down at the marked spot for the Inquisition headquarters and keep going down to the **2nd underground floor**. {npc:Jack Springer} is in a room on that floor.
Way down to the Inquisition headquarters

Talk to {npc:Jack Springer}: say {key:hi} and then {key:late}. He asks you to go round the knights' graves and reminds you that you will need very potent holy water. If you want to hear the full story, instead of {key:late} start with {key:mission} and follow the keywords in the table, in order: the last one is {key:late}.
Say {key:trade} to {npc:Jack Springer} and buy {item:Vial of Potent Holy Water|Vials of Potent Holy Water} (100 gp each). Take several, so you don't have to come back halfway through the quest.
Ask for the list of graves
Say {key:report} and then {key:locations}. Jack tells you where the **12 graves** you have to protect are. The table summarises them and gives the section of this guide for each one.
Cobra Bastion minibosses + holy water (Scarlett Etzel optional)
Holy water after the 6 ogre puzzles
Ancient temple north of Thais ({wiki:Ancient Temple})
All grave bosses accept teams of up to 5 players and can be repeated every 20 hours. Use this table to prepare runes, weapons and protection before each fight.
To leave, go back up the same way, 2 floors, to the streets of Thais. You come back here at the end, after the 12 graves.
Exit to the streets of Thais
Reach the cemetery north of Edron

Go to **Edron** by boat (in Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}). Leave the city to the **north**, on foot, to the cemetery on top of a hill.
Cemetery on the hill north of Edron
In the cemetery, go down **2 floors**. Go through the quest door and enter the vortex: you reach the lever room, with the spots for the team.
Put the team (up to **5 players**) on the marked spots and pull the lever. You will face {creature:Count Vlarkorth}.
You can only repeat this boss 20 hours later.
Count Vlarkorth and the Soulless Minions

{creature:Count Vlarkorth} appears with 5 {creature:Soulless Minion|Soulless Minions}. The minions heal the boss, so one player should pull them away from it (they deal very little damage). Attack the boss with **death** damage and use **fire** protection: most of the damage comes from a strong fire wave, so the blocker should stand **diagonally** to the boss.
You can trap the boss in a corner using {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}; this makes the fight much safer.

At some point Count Vlarkorth becomes **invulnerable** and summons one *Dark* creature for each player in the room, according to their vocation. Kill them and use each one's corpse **on the boss**, with a player of the matching vocation: only then does it become vulnerable again. Repeat until you kill it.
Remains to use on the boss
The Soulless Minions also heal the Dark creatures: don't let them near those or the boss.
You don't need every vocation: if there are no Sorcerers in the team, no Dark Sorcerers appear. With 2 Paladins, 2 Dark Paladins appear.

The spoiler doesn't describe the exit from the boss room. After the fight, go back the way you came in to the surface (go up the 2 floors) and walk back **south** to Edron harbour, where {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to other cities.

The {wiki:Dark Cathedral} lies **west** of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}, **south** of the Outlaw Camp and the Venore swamp, and you can only get there by crossing the plains. Go to **Venore** (from Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Captain Fearless}), leave the city to the **south-west**, cross the Plains of Havoc and continue to the entrance.
In the middle of the plains there may be {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} lured by other players.
Go down the stairs **1 floor** and go to the room to the **south**. Use the {item:Vial of Potent Holy Water} on the grave.
The grave in the south room of the Dark Cathedral
Go up the same stairs to the surface and head back across the plains to the **north-east** to Venore, where {npc:Captain Fearless} takes you to other cities.

Go to **Carlin** (from Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Captain Greyhound}). The {wiki:Ghostlands} lie **west** of the city: enter them by going under the wall through the marked hole.
Hole under the wall to the Ghostlands
Go down into the small crypt

Head **south** to the small crypt and go down the hole at the entrance (the wiki calls it *Second Hole*). Down there, go **north** to the grave and enter the vortex: it takes you to the lever room, where the team (up to **5 players**) takes position to enter.
Lord Azaram and the Condensed Sins

{creature:Lord Azaram} appears with {creature:Condensed Sin|Condensed Sins}. Kill the Sins with area attacks to reduce the damage the team takes, which is considerable. Attack with fire, death or ice; do **not** use earth.
The Condensed Sins reflect death damage: don't use {item:Sudden Death Rune} or death beams on them. The boss sometimes applies {wiki:Hexed|Lesser Hex}, which cuts the healing received to about half.

Shortly after the start, Lord Azaram turns into {creature:Azaram's Soul} and {creature:Tainted Soul Splinter|Tainted Soul Splinters} appear. Kill the Splinters: they turn into {item:Cleansed Soul Splinter|Cleansed Soul Splinters}. Lure Azaram's Soul onto them to **heal** it. You have to do this **3 times** to force Lord Azaram to come back.

In the first rounds you can speed things up with {spell:Mass Healing} and {item:Ultimate Healing Rune|Ultimate Healing Runes} on Azaram's Soul; later it is at full health and you really have to lure it onto the Splinters.
Repeat the two phases (Lord Azaram and Azaram's Soul) until you kill Lord Azaram.

The spoiler doesn't describe the exit from the boss room. Go back the way you came in to the crypt and use the {item:Rope} on the entrance hole to climb up to the surface. Then head back **north-east** to the hole under the wall and to Carlin. {npc:Captain Greyhound} takes you back to Thais ({key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}).
Crypt hole (climb up with the Rope)
Hole under the city wall (back to Carlin)

{wiki:Cormaya} is a small island south of **Edron**. At the boat in northern Edron, talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (20 gp). You land at the **north** harbour of Cormaya, next to {npc:Pemaret}; from there, walk to the cemetery.
In the cemetery, go down the hole and enter the vortex. You will face {creature:Earl Osam} with your team (up to **5 players**).
Earl Osam and the Frozen Souls

The biggest danger is the summons, the {creature:Frozen Soul|Frozen Souls}: there are many of them and they deal a lot of {wiki:Ice Damage|ice damage} at range. To protect the shooters, the blocker stays near the **centre** of the room and the shooters stand against a **wall**, so the Frozen Souls go after the Knight on the other side. Attack the boss with **fire** and use protection against ice or earth; avoid death and ice.

After attacking for a while, the boss teleports to the centre of the room and becomes invulnerable ({creature:Channeling Earl Osam}). 4 {creature:Magical Sphere|Magical Spheres} appear, one on each side of the room, and move towards him. Kill them as fast as possible: each one that reaches him heals him for **80,000** health points, and if more than one gets there he will almost certainly be back at full health. The team has to switch targets quickly to kill at least 3 in time.
Shortly after you kill the Spheres, Channeling Earl Osam teleports away any players standing **next to** him (not diagonally) and returns to his vulnerable form.
You usually have to repeat the Spheres phase **once or twice** before Earl Osam dies.

The spoiler doesn't describe the exit from the boss room. Go back the way you came in and use the {item:Rope} on the cemetery hole to climb up. Then go to the **north** harbour and talk to {npc:Pemaret}: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (20 gp).

The {wiki:Femor Hills} lie between **Carlin**, **Ab'Dendriel** and **Kazordoon**. The simplest route is to take a boat to Carlin ({key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}) and walk **east**. Bring a {item:Rope}.
Go up **1 floor** and look for the grave inside the **south-west** mountain. Use the {item:Vial of Potent Holy Water} on it. This grave has already been desecrated: there is nothing more to do here.
Map of the 1st floor above Femor Hills
Go back down the same way to ground level and walk back **west** to Carlin (or **south** to Kazordoon).
7. Cobra Bastion grave (island north-east of Ankrahmun)

This is the longest grave. You have to enter the {wiki:Cobra Bastion}, the fortress of the {wiki:Order of the Cobra}, and unlock access to the basement. For Grave Danger you only need to kill Gaffir and the Custodian and use the holy water; the rest (Guard Captain Quaid, the chess puzzle and Scarlett Etzel) is optional, but recommended for the equipment Scarlett drops. Attack everything with fire, avoid earth and protect yourself against earth and death.

Travel to **Ankrahmun** by boat (for example from Venore or Darashia: {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}). The Cobra Bastion is **north-east** of the Ankrahmun desert, on an island. The wiki does not describe the exact path to the entrance: use the coordinate on the map to find your way. Only characters of level **250+** can enter.

It is very similar to the {wiki:Falcon Bastion}: you kill **3 minibosses** and each one opens a new part of the fortress. Some doors only stay open for good if you open them **from the right side**: open every one you find from the inside. Around the fortress there are Order of the Cobra documents, a key and other secrets.
Key 0303 (opens several doors in the fortress)
In a chest on the ground floor there is a flask of oil used to set fire to the creepers that block the entrance to the 4th floor from the ground.
Since 18 April 2023 you can no longer stand inside the burning walls where Gaffir and Guard Captain Quaid appear: the damage became unbearable.
Go up the ramp in the **south** part of the fortress and then go up **2 floors**. On the 3rd floor, go to the **south-east** room: {creature:Gaffir} is there. Kill him to gain access to the basement.

If you put Gaffir's corpse in the basin ({item:Fire Basin}) in the centre of his room and then step on the carpet with the price tag, you are sent to a small room with the document {item:Dealings of the Knightly Orders in Zao (Book)}, the last part of the chess moves.
About 3 minutes after you enter you are teleported out: it is not a safe zone.

Go back to the ground floor and down to the **basement**. Follow the corridors on the **west** side, always heading **south**. In the southernmost room is the {creature:Custodian}: kill it to unlock the final area of the fortress.
The grave is in the room **north** of the Custodian's. Use the {item:Vial of Potent Holy Water} on it. For the Grave Danger Quest, that is all you need to do in the Cobra Bastion.
Grave on the island north-east of Ankrahmun sanctified

Killing the Custodian also lets you cross the flames **east** of his room, but **only once**: if you go back to his room, you have to kill him again to use that shortcut. In the corridor to the east is the {creature:Cart Packed with Gold}. If you like, help it reach the far **north** end of the corridor by destroying the {creature:Clutter|Clutters} along the way and keeping it alive. If you kill it at the destination, you can loot something valuable. The Cart sometimes drops {item:Wheel Oil}: use it on the Cart to make it jump a few tiles.
Go back up and pass the smoke wall to the **4th floor**, where {creature:Guard Captain Quaid} is. He fights at range. Kill him to open the final part.

With Quaid dead, a new area opens on the **6th floor**. Use {spell:Levitate} to go up onto the bridge in the centre of the room and again to come down on the other side. Then use the {item:Rope} on the trapdoor in the centre of the room to go down. Open the doors **from the inside** to keep permanent access.

In the chessboard room, move the pieces according to the moves described in the 4 documents found in the fortress (they are all in the image) and put a {item:Cheesy Figurine} in place of the missing queen. With the right game, an energy effect appears on screen (it deals no damage) and a {creature:Roaring Lion} spawns.
Everyone in the room at that moment gains access: bring your team with you.
Go back to the **1st floor**: you can now pass the metal wall into a small room. From there you enter {creature:Scarlett Etzel}'s room with up to **5 players**.
You can only repeat this boss 20 hours later.

Scarlett starts out immortal. To make her vulnerable, use {item:Galthen's Chestplate}, which appears on a display near the throne: she stops moving and becomes vulnerable for **8 seconds**. The fastest way is to attack her when the **4 mirrors** around her are facing her: she takes **7,500** damage, but at the same time she unleashes the *Ultimate Poison Explosion*, which deals 7,500 damage to the players around her.
Only **one** player should attack: she immediately becomes invulnerable, and attacking her when she is not vulnerable **heals her** for 5,000 hit points.
Follow this sequence; **4 rounds** done right are enough to kill her.
Throw {item:Galthen's Chestplate} into the centre of the mirrors.
Turn (use) the 4 mirrors until they face the centre of the square where Scarlett is.
Use Galthen's Chestplate and wait 2 seconds, to make sure she has stopped.
Step away and attack her **just once**, so she takes the 7,500 damage.
Lure Scarlett to the left and run to the right (or block her) until the Chestplate appears again (30 seconds).
Turn the four mirrors until they face Scarlett
Step away and attack her just once
The wiki does not describe the way out: go back the way you came to the fortress entrance and return to Ankrahmun, where {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to other cities.

The grave is at the bottom of the dungeon of the *The Revenge of the Ogres* mission of the {wiki:Kilmaresh Quest}, after the **6 puzzles**. The first 4 are a requirement for this quest; you have to pass puzzles 5 and 6 now.

Go to the island of {wiki:Kilmaresh}, whose capital is **Issavi**. There are boats from **Venore** ({npc:Captain Fearless}), **Darashia** ({npc:Petros}), **Krailos** and **Oramond**: {key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes}. You arrive at Issavi harbour, next to {npc:Captain Harava}'s boat.
Getting to Saideh and the dungeon

Go round through the Central and Southern Steppe to the **west** side of the Green Belt and enter Kilmaresh Mountain. Swim in the river and pass **behind the waterfall**, where {npc:Saideh} is. Enter the cave, go down one floor and pass the cage you opened with the {item:Wooden Cage Key} (it stays open for good). Go down the stairs, head **north** and enter the small room to the **west** with 4 {item:Magic Forcefield|Magic Forcefields}.
Cage opened with the Wooden Cage Key
Get through the 6 puzzles of the ogre dungeon. You already did the first 4 in the {wiki:Kilmaresh Quest}; 5 and 6 are new (the images show each puzzle):
Enter the teleport with your vocation's item (the wrong one sends you to the surface of the Green Belt).
Enter the teleport that matches the number of lit basins (0 = leftmost, 3 = rightmost).
Enter the teleport whose black strip has at least one {creature:Mummy} on it at that moment.
The 4 tiles to the south show the safe tile of each of the 4 rows: memorise them and cross.
Enter the teleport of the tile type that appears most often in the two rectangles.
Step on all the Sparkles without passing over the same one twice; if you make a mistake, use the lever to the west to start again.
Puzzle 2: the three basins and the four teleports
Puzzle 3: the black stripes and the mummies
Puzzle 4: each tile to the south matches a row
Puzzle 5: the two rectangles and the teleports
Puzzle 6: a possible route through the maze
If you enter the wrong teleport in puzzle 1 you are sent to the surface of the Green Belt.
After the 6 puzzles, go down to the floor below and use the {item:Vial of Potent Holy Water} on the sarcophagus (the Kilmaresh grave).
You are only allowed down to this last floor if you have the Grave Danger Quest active (you have already spoken to Jack Springer).
Go back the same way to the stairs, go up to the cage floor and leave the cave by the waterfall. Return to Issavi and take {npc:Captain Harava}'s boat to the mainland.

Take a boat to **Yalahar** (for example in Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}; the Venore boat does not go to Yalahar). At the **Trade Quarter** docks (straight **south** from the main gate), talk to {npc:Harlow}: {key:hi}, {key:vengoth}, {key:yes} (100 gp). He only takes you if you have already started mission 4 of the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest}. He drops you off in the **west** of {wiki:Vengoth}.
Harlow (arrival in the west of Vengoth)
Cross Vengoth heading **east** all the way from the boat to the grave and use the {item:Vial of Potent Holy Water} on it. This one has also already been desecrated: there is nothing more to do.
The grave in the east of Vengoth
Go back **west** to {npc:Harlow} and say {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes} (50 gp): he takes you to the Trade Quarter docks in Yalahar. From there take a boat to your city.
10. Darashia grave — Sir Baeloc and Sir Nictros

Travel to **Darashia** by boat (from Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Petros}) or by magic carpet. The cemetery is **east** of the city: it is the entrance to the {wiki:Deeper Catacombs}, in south-east Darashia, next to the carpet and the boat.
According to the wiki, the trip from Venore to Darashia has a 10% chance of leaving you on the Ghostship.
Putting out and lighting the statues
Put out the **west**, **south-east** and **south** {item:Sacred Statue|Sacred Statues}, but leave the **north** and **north-east** ones **lit**.
The statues and the sundial at the catacombs entrance
Using the sundial and going down

Use the {item:Sundial}: you hear a *CLICK* in the **south-west** room, where the secret stairs appear inside a coffin. Go down them to the **2nd underground floor**, keep heading **south** and then **east** to the grave. This is where you fight the two brothers: get your team (up to **5 players**) into position and pull the lever.
Once you go down, the secret stairs disappear and the statues light up again.

After you pull the lever, you see the two bosses waiting in a small closed area to the **north**. A few seconds later {creature:Sir Nictros} comes out and summons {creature:Squire of Nictros|Squires of Nictros}. As the summons deal considerable damage, it is best to keep killing them; with a second Knight you can keep them away from the boss instead. Attack with **fire**; avoid death and earth.
These bosses use {wiki:Status Condition|Lesser Hex}, which greatly reduces the healing received. The blocker has to watch the status bar and be ready to heal less.

When Sir Nictros reaches about **60%** health, he withdraws and is replaced by {creature:Sir Baeloc}. Deal with him the same way (kill or keep away his summons, the {creature:Retainer of Baeloc|Retainers of Baeloc}). When he reaches about 60%, his brother returns and you fight both at the same time.

Hit both with area attacks. The key is to keep both their health **roughly equal**: from a certain point on, the one with less health heals about **18,000** points. Take extra care with Lesser Hex: it appears more often and the damage is higher.

The spoiler does not describe the way out from the lower floor, and the secret stairs in the coffin disappear after you go down. Go back the way you came to the cemetery entrance, in south-east Darashia (bring a {item:Rope} just in case); if you need to open the stairs again, repeat the statues and the sundial. {npc:Petros} takes you by boat to other cities.
11. Thais Ancient Temple grave — Duke Krule

Leave **Thais** through the **north** gate: the {wiki:Ancient Temple} is just **north-west** of that gate. Go in and down through the temple floors to the main room with {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} (**4 floors** below ground). Bring a {item:Rope}.
**South** of the Rotworm room you find the grave and the vortex that leads to {creature:Duke Krule}. Go in with your team (up to **5 players**).
Rotworm room, with the grave to the south
Duke Krule and the Soul Scourges

In the room are {creature:Duke Krule} and {creature:Soul Scourge|Soul Scourges}. The summons can hit harder than the boss himself: if you have two Knights, one takes the boss and the other the summons. Attack with **fire**, avoid death and protect yourself against death.

A few seconds later, all players are transformed into a **Water Elemental** or **Fire Elemental**, and every turn a large spell of the same element appears around each of them. If two players with **different** appearances stand close to each other, they take about **2,000** damage. The Knight stays in the **centre** of the room with the boss and the others around him, at a safe distance.

The transformation changes every few seconds. If a shooter has a summon behind them, they can wait until they have the same appearance as the Knight and quickly bring it to him, before the appearance changes again.

The spoiler does not describe the way out of the boss room. Go back the way you came in to the Rotworm room and go up the 4 floors of the temple (use the {item:Rope} where you went down through holes). You come out north-west of the north gate of Thais.
12. Grave at the entrance to the orc lands

The grave is on the way to the Orc Fortress ({wiki:Ulderek's Rock}). Go to **Venore** (from Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}) and walk **north-west** (or from Kazordoon **north-east**) to the {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns} mountain shown. Bring a {item:Rope}.
Go down the hole in the Wyvern mountain and use the {item:Vial of Potent Holy Water} on the grave. It has already been desecrated: there is nothing more to do.
The grave at the entrance to the orc lands
Use the {item:Rope} on the hole to get back to the surface and walk back to Venore (or Kazordoon).

{wiki:Folda} is the largest of the Ice Islands, west of Carlin. Go to **Carlin** (from Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}) and then to the boatman {npc:Nielson}, **north-west** of the city: {key:hi}, {key:folda}, {key:yes} (20 gp). You land at the Folda dock, next to {npc:Svenson}.
Go into the Folda mountain to the grave and use the {item:Vial of Potent Holy Water} on it. It has already been desecrated: there is nothing more to do.
The grave inside the Folda mountain
Leave the mountain the same way and go back to the dock. Talk to {npc:Svenson}: {key:hi}, {key:tibia}, {key:yes}. The trip back to the mainland is free.

With the 12 graves sanctified, the cultists give up their search: they have gathered enough lich-knights to try to resurrect {creature:King Zelos}, hidden beneath the Isle of the Kings. The fight is for up to **10 players** and a full team is recommended.
Go back to the Inquisition headquarters in Thais (section 1) and say {key:report}, {key:ultimate} and {key:threat} to {npc:Jack Springer}. He sends you to the {wiki:Isle of the Kings}.
Get to the Isle of the Kings

Go to **Carlin** and then to {npc:Dalbrect}'s hut and boat, at the harbour **north and west** of the city (north of the Ghostlands). Say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}: he takes you to the {wiki:Isle of the Kings} for 10 gp (only if you are already his friend, through {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest}).
Dalbrect (boat to the Isle of the Kings)
Access to King Zelos is behind a sealed door on **floor -1** of the island (see the floor -1 map). Go in with your team (up to **10 players**).
Map of floor -1 of the Isle of the Kings

The island's catacombs have *warded doors* that you can only open after talking to Abbot {npc:Costello}, in the building on the **east** of the island: {key:hi}, {key:fugio}, {key:yes} (this is the start of the second part of {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest}). If you haven't done it yet and come across one of those doors, talk to him first.

You have **24 minutes** to defeat Zelos before you are kicked out of the room. First the team has to kill the **4 lich-knights** performing the ritual, each in their own room; you can move freely between the rooms and kill them in any order you like. The longer you take, the stronger Zelos becomes.
If you don't kill the 4 minibosses within about **12 minutes**, King Zelos becomes too strong (or even immune to all damage) and it becomes impossible to kill him.
Centre (teleport in the middle of the north corridor)

The whole team first goes **east** to kill Rewar the Bloody. Then the team splits: 2–3 players (including a Knight and a Druid) go **west** to deal with The Red Knight and the rest go **north** to kill Magnor Mournbringer. As the Red Knight is the quickest, that group joins the others as they are finishing Magnor. Finally, everyone goes to the **north-west** corner for Nargol the Impaler. With all 4 dead, it is King Zelos's turn.

With {creature:Rewar the Bloody} are {creature:Risen Soldier|Risen Soldiers} and {creature:Fetter|Fetters}. The boss is only vulnerable when **no Fetters are alive**, so kill them as fast as possible and, when the boss is vulnerable, hit him with everything before he becomes immune again. Positioning: 4 players surround the **centre** tile of the room (where Rewar appears every time he changes form), with the Knights on the sides and the shooters (preferably Paladins) to the north and south, so the boss does not face them. The other 6 stand around the spots where the Fetters spawn (west, east and north/south of each one, recognisable by the blue effect): that way the Fetters do not spread around the room. Sorcerers preferably to the north and south (for the waves), Druids on the sides (for {spell:Mass Healing}).

With this layout, all shooters can use {item:Great Fireball Rune|Great Fireball Runes} on the exact centre of the room: they hit the Fetters and the boss. When the boss is clearly vulnerable, the mages use their waves on him.
Finish this part in under **6 minutes**, otherwise it will be very hard to kill King Zelos in time.

It is the easiest of the 4: 2 or 3 players are enough, and splitting the team saves a lot of time. {creature:The Red Knight} only takes {wiki:Drown Damage|drown damage}, which comes from killing the {creature:Vampiric Blood|Vampiric Bloods} around him: make sure the Vampiric Bloods die **next to** the boss. Protect yourself against drown.
The {creature:Risen Soldier|Risen Soldiers} can be dangerous for such a small group: that is why it is safer to bring a 3rd player.

At first you just attack {creature:Magnor Mournbringer}. When he dies, he splits into 4 {creature:Shard of Magnor|Shards of Magnor}, which you also have to kill. The Shards share the same health, so you can attack just one. When they die, they explode for about 2,000 life drain damage each: to avoid taking it all, split them into groups of two, so the blockers don't take all four explosions. Protect yourself against earth and life drain.

{creature:Nargol the Impaler} can be attacked with **fire** from the start, with no special mechanics. When he dies, a {creature:Regenerating Mass} appears in the centre of the room and you have **30 seconds** to kill it; if you fail, Nargol returns with full health. Use all the damage you can here.

Trap the boss in the centre of the room with players and summoned {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}: when the Regenerating Mass appears it is already trapped and the team only has to damage it.
Failing this boss once almost always ruins the whole fight and makes King Zelos immortal.

With the 4 lich-knights dead, enter the teleport in the middle of the **north** corridor to reach {creature:King Zelos}'s room. The biggest danger is {wiki:Status Condition|Greater Hex}, which reduces the target's maximum health to **40%**: it is applied by the boss's beam, so the blockers always stay **diagonal** to him. If Zelos is blocked near the **west** wall, the blocker can keep him facing the wall (and not the team) and quickly change position if he moves. The shooters only attack him with **fire**, preferably {item:Fireball Rune|Fireball Runes} for maximum single-target damage.

Anyone with Greater Hex can remove it by stepping on the vortex in the centre of the room, but that spawns an {creature:Unleashed Hex}, which is quite strong. It is often better for the team to communicate and focus healing on the blocking Knight.

There are 3 {creature:Risen Soldier|Risen Soldiers} in the room: block them with a second Knight or with the shooters (preferably Paladins). There is no point killing them, they come back straight away. If the minibosses died quickly, Zelos is weak enough to die.
Leave the Isle of the Kings

If you don't kill the king within 24 minutes, you are kicked out of the room. The spoiler does not describe the way out of the boss room: go back the way you came in to the sealed door on floor -1 and go up to the surface. To return to the mainland, go to the boat moored at the island and talk to {npc:Captain Jack}, Dalbrect's friend: say {key:hi} and {key:tibia}. He takes you to the Carlin side; from there {npc:Captain Greyhound} takes you to Thais ({key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}).

According to the wiki, Captain Jack only takes you back with {npc:Costello}'s permission, and won't take you if you entered the 3rd floor (restricted area) of the monastery without paying Costello the fine ({key:crime} or {key:absolution}).

Go back to **Thais**, to the Inquisition headquarters, and report to {npc:Jack Springer} to receive the rewards: the **Hand of the Inquisition** base outfit and the **Inquisition's Hand** achievement.
Official artwork of the Hand of the Inquisition outfit (originally called Tomb Assassin)
Hand of the Inquisition outfit (base) and Inquisition's Hand achievement
All the grave bosses, {creature:Scarlett Etzel} and {creature:King Zelos} can be repeated every **20 hours**.

The outfit addons are obtained in the {wiki:Hand of the Inquisition Outfits Quest}: the first with a {item:Final Judgement} and the second with a {item:Shadow Cowl} (which can drop from King Zelos himself).
Completing Order of the Cobra access (Cobra Bastion) in this quest is a requirement for {wiki:The Order of the Lion Quest}, along with Order of the Falcon access from {wiki:The Secret Library Quest}.

In the Cobra Bastion there are {item:Brass-Shod Chest|Brass-Shod Chests} you can open once every 24 hours ({item:Cobra Crest|Cobra Crests}, {item:Life Ring|Life Rings}, {item:Gold Ingot}, etc.). If you use a {item:Flask with Snake Poison} on the {item:Large Cauldron} on the 2nd floor ({coord:33399,32663,5}), the cobras spawn with 2,000 less health for 30 minutes.
While you are killing the Cobra Bastion minibosses an {creature:Ugly Monster} may appear: kill it quickly, because it can drop any piece of the valuable Cobra set.
The outfit was originally called *Tomb Assassin* (as seen in the official artwork) and was renamed Hand of the Inquisition at launch.
